Planning Document: Marrickville DCP 2011 - 9 39 Marrickville Metro

Clause 9.39.2 - heritage (heritage_protection): To protect the identified Heritage Items within the precinct.

Clause 9.39.2 - zoning (land_use_zoning): To protect the integrity and on-going retention of the existing industrial zoned land, particularly those identified as being of State significance.

Clause 9.39.2 - zoning (land_use_zoning): To retain the existing employment generating land uses.

Clause 9.39.2 - other (development_control): To ensure that the redevelopment of the Marrickville Metro shopping centre addresses existing conflicts between the operation of the centre and the amenity of surrounding residential areas.

Clause 9.39.2 - other (development_control): To protect significant streetscapes and/or public domain elements within the precinct including landscaping, fencing, open space, sandstone kerbing and guttering, views and vistas and prevailing subdivision patterns.

Clause 9.39.2 - other (development_control): To enhance existing streets and encourage pedestrian activity, where appropriate, through improvements to road infrastructure and landscaping.

Clause 9.39.2 - other (development_control): To support pedestrian and cyclist access, activity and amenity including maintaining and enhancing the public domain quality.

Clause 9.39.2 - parking (development_control): To facilitate efficient parking, loading and access for vehicles that minimises impact to streetscape appearance, commercial viability and vitality and pedestrian safety and amenity.
